events.description: Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat around tables in a banquet hall; people are seen grabbing, pushing, and striking each other in a chaotic brawl.

A large group of people erupts into collective violent unrest: chairs are overturned, tables disrupted, and multiple clusters of aggressive physical confrontation occur simultaneously across the room.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat across the banquet hall, including punching, grappling, and shoving; the fight escalates from a localized disturbance to a widespread brawl involving dozens of people.

A large group of people collectively engages in violent unrest: tables are overturned, chairs are thrown or used as weapons, and the crowd surges chaotically throughout the hall, indicating organized or spontaneous group violence beyond isolated fights.
Multiple individuals engaged in mutual physical combat within a crowded indoor space; visible pushing, grabbing, and striking actions among several men across the sequence.

Large group of people involved in chaotic, collective violent unrest with overlapping scuffles, dense crowd movement, and apparent coordinated aggression; not merely a crowd but sustained group-level conflict.

A dense crowd is engaged in mutual physical combat: individuals are seen pushing, shoving, grabbing, and striking each other; arms are raised in aggressive gestures, and bodies are tightly interlocked in struggle.

The scene escalates into collective violent unrest: multiple groups clash simultaneously, security personnel in green uniforms intervene amid chaotic movement, tables are displaced, and the overall environment shows loss of order typical of a riot.

A man in a beige shirt is actively engaged in a physical altercation with multiple individuals, including security personnel in green uniforms; he is seen pointing, shouting, pushing, and being restrained across multiple frames.

The scene escalates into a chaotic group confrontation involving numerous civilians and uniformed officers, with pushing, grabbing, and crowd surging indicative of collective violent unrest within the banquet hall.

A physical altercation occurs in the crowd: a man in a beige jacket (visible from f2 onward) is actively pushing and grappling with others, including a man in black; uniformed officers intervene to separate them. The struggle involves mutual pushing and grabbing, consistent with mutual physical combat.

A chaotic, densely packed crowd with multiple individuals engaged in aggressive shoving, shouting, and physical contact; uniformed personnel are attempting crowd control amid visible tension and disorder, indicating collective violent unrest rather than isolated conflict.

A man in a suit places his hand on the shoulder/neck area of another man in a casual shirt, who appears passive and does not resist; the gesture appears controlling or coercive rather than consensual or supportive.
